name: UniversityFlow

tables.definition: Unified student information from the three university examples

columns.name: student_id
columns.definition: Student identifier shared across the three combined examples

columns.name: name
columns.definition: Student name

columns.name: date_of_birth
columns.definition: Birth date; not an academic event

columns.name: phone_number
columns.definition: Student contact number

columns.name: home_address
columns.definition: Student postal address

columns.name: registration_eligibility
columns.definition: Current eligibility, ELIGIBLE or INELIGIBLE; changes are not timestamped

columns.name: class
columns.definition: Student class or cohort

columns.name: major
columns.definition: Student major

tables.definition: Course offerings and planned teaching schedules

columns.name: course_id
columns.definition: Course-offering identifier

columns.name: course_name
columns.definition: Course title

columns.name: credits
columns.definition: Academic credit units

columns.name: instructor
columns.definition: Instructor name as stored in the registration source; no FK to instructor is assumed

columns.name: class_time
columns.definition: Planned teaching time; not proof that a class occurred

columns.name: class_location
columns.definition: Planned teaching location

columns.name: course_offering_proposed_at

columns.name: course_offering_closed_at

tables.definition: Every recorded grading action, including regrading

columns.name: assignment_id
columns.definition: Assignment identifier

columns.name: instructor_id
columns.definition: Instructor identifier

columns.name: grading_time
columns.definition: Actual grading time in UTC; regrading creates another composite-key row

columns.name: score
columns.definition: Assignment grade, 0 to 100

columns.name: evaluation
columns.definition: Instructor feedback

columns.name: grading_kind
columns.definition: Physical business-action code in assignment_grading; A = Original; R = Reassessment. Recorded occurrence time is given by the corresponding event timestamp; the code alone is not proof of occurrence.

columns.name: reassessment_event_id
columns.definition: Stable identity of an authored reassessment occurrence. The source composite PK remains unchanged; distinct reassessments have distinct occurrence IDs.

note: Standardized metadata projection. Original input/data_dictionary.json remains authoritative for additional fields; no evaluator Gold included.
